description: This file contains unit tests for the ContactsHandler component in an Android app, using JUnit and Robolectric. It tests permission handling, contact search, and contact addition functionalities, employing a fake data source for testing.

classes.name: ContactsHandlerTest
classes.description: Test suite for the ContactsHandler class, verifying permission checks, contact search, and addition functionalities.

methods.name: handleContactsSearch_requiresReadPermission
methods.description: Tests that the contacts search requires read permissions.

methods.name: handleContactsAdd_rejectsEmptyContact
methods.description: Tests that adding an empty contact is rejected.

methods.name: handleContactsSearch_returnsContacts
methods.description: Verifies that contacts are returned correctly when searching.

methods.name: handleContactsAdd_returnsAddedContact
methods.description: Verifies that a contact is successfully added and the response contains the correct data.
